Burning Chop Lv. 1 Fire attacks enemies in front with 167 Power added to P. Atk., causes burns, and makes them consume 43 HP every second. Cannot be used when a bow/crossbow is equipped. Over-hit. Critical.

Chant of Life Lv. 1 Recovers all party members HP by 5%. Recovers 12 HP per second for all party members.
